title: Finite rank-stratum reconstruction over a closed-immersion algebra
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion], put $A=i_*\mathcal O_Z$ and let $g:(Z,\mathcal O_Z)\to(Y,A)$ be [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. Choose derived categories on $Z$ and over $A$ with independent universes [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $M$ be any $\mathcal O_Z$-module sheaf, and $r:Z\to\mathbb N$ a locally constant function with finite image. Suppose $K\in D(A)$ has for every $n\in\mathbb Z$ an isomorphism of $A$-module sheaves $H^n(K)\cong g_*\operatorname{locallyRankedExteriorTerm}(M,r,n)$, with the terms of [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex]. Then $Rg_*Q(\operatorname{locallyRankedExteriorComplex}(M,r))\cong K$, with the derived direct image of [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. No regularity, normal-sheaf condition on $M$, scalar right adjoint, or quasi-coherence hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Install finite-limit preservation from the module pullback-pushforward adjunction. Install finite-colimit preservation from the closed-embedding algebra direct-image lemma. The proved source-library rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory and mapDerivedCategoryFactors then identify Rg_*Q(C) with Q(g_*C) for C=locallyRankedExteriorComplex(M,r), without any boundedness or quasi-coherence assumption.

For each natural n choose the actual exterior sheaf of the restriction of M to the clopen rank-n open. By the definitions, locallyRankedExteriorTerm is the direct image of this sheaf for nonnegative degree and zero for negative degree. Apply clopenRankStrata_formality to this explicit family and the given hK, then compose its isomorphism with the exact-derived-functor comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem closedImmersion_rankedCohomology_reconstruction
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wZ} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i)))]
    (M : Z.Modules) (r : LocallyConstant Z ℕ) (hfinite : (Set.range r).Finite)
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))))
    (hK : ∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) n).obj K ≅
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace i)).obj
          (Scheme.Modules.locallyRankedExteriorTerm M r n))) :
    Nonempty ((RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImage
      (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace i)).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (Scheme.Modules.locallyRankedExteriorComplex M r)) ≅ K)
